content: For individuals diagnosed with diabetes and established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), the American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the use of high-intensity statin therapy. This therapeutic approach is specifically indicated to reduce the risk of recurrent ASCVD events. Evidence from meta-analyses demonstrates that high-intensity statin therapy significantly lowers low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol levels. This reduction in LDL cholesterol is associated with meaningful decreases in both cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.
